known_facts_book1: Dorothy's small black curly dog, who comes to Oz with the party.
Is an especial friend of the Shaggy Man and is petted by everyone in the Emerald City.
Wanders off with Dorothy and Billina in the forest and gets lost with them.
Barks at the Spoon Brigade in Utensia, and is left behind by Dorothy at the Cuttenclips' paper town.
Is named in Dorothy's farewell note as one who will always love the author and the children.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: His mistress, whom he follows everywhere and beside whom he gets lost.
known_relations_book1.Billina: Lost in the forest with him and Dorothy.

not_in_this_book: Toto is left behind in Kansas

known_facts_book1: A Yellow Hen, the first hen ever seen in Oz, whom Dorothy brought there from Ev.
Lives in her own little house and is proud of her large family of chicks and grandchildren.
Is respected so much that the Oz people will not eat her or her chickens, though they eat surplus eggs.
Wanders off with Dorothy and Toto in the forest and shares the adventures at Utensia, Bunbury and Bunnybury.
Warns Dorothy not to provoke the Spoon Brigade, since none of the three of them is a fairy in this fairy country.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: Her beloved mistress, who brought her to Oz and gets lost with her.
known_relations_book1.Toto: Lost in the forest with her and Dorothy.
